summary: Otto Strauss was an Indologist and philosopher who studied at Munich, Berlin, and Kiel, completing his doctorate under Hermann Oldenberg and habilitation under Paul Deussen. He held professorships at the University of Calcutta (1913–1920), Kiel (1920), and Breslau (1928–1935).

Otto von Böhtlingk was a scholar of Indology and linguistics who studied in Saint Petersburg, Berlin, and Bonn under Franz Bopp and Christian Lassen. He served at the Imperial Academy of Sciences (1842–1868) and held posts at Jena and the DMG.

Owen Flanagan is a philosopher and scholar of Buddhist studies. He studied at Archbishop Stepinac High School, Fordham University, and Boston University, and became Professor of Philosophy at Duke University around 1996.

P. B. Annangaracharya was an Indologist and scholar of philosophy and religious studies. He studied under Asuri Ramanujacharya and was attested in 1954 as Head Pandit at Sanskrit Pathashala in Vadtal.
P. B. Meegaskumbura works in Indology, linguistics, and Buddhist studies. He served as a professor at the University of Peradeniya, with his post attested in 1991 and 2010.
P. H. Joshi is an Indologist who served at the Oriental Institute, Vadodara, holding the post of Research Officer as attested from 1976 to 1988, with affiliation further attested in 2002.

P. K. Mukhopadhyay is a scholar of philosophy and Indology. He served as Professor of Philosophy at Jadavpur University and was attested as a National Fellow at the Indian Council of Philosophical Research in 2009.

P. N. Pattabhirama Sastri was an Indologist and philosopher who studied under A. Chinnaswami Sastri. He worked at Banaras Hindu University as an assistant (attested 1941) and served as Reader in Sanskrit at the University of Calcutta (~1957–1967).

P. P. Subrahmanya Sastri was an Indologist who earned an M.A. from the University of Madras and a B.A. from Oxford. He served as Curator of the Government Oriental Manuscripts Library and headed Sanskrit at Presidency College, Chennai.

P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Bishop Heber College, Saidapet, and Madras. He held positions at Bishop Heber College, the University of Madras, Rajah's College, and Annamalai University (1942–1947).

P. Swaminathan is an Indologist who completed an M.Litt. at the University of Madras under V. Raghavan by 1956. He served as a Lecturer in Sanskrit at Rashtriya Sanskrit Vidyapeetha, attested in 1965.
P. T. Narasimhachar worked in Indology and other fields. He studied at Maharaja's College, Mysore, under Mysore Hiriyanna from approximately 1923 to 1926.
P. V. Ramanujaswami was an Indologist who served as Director and head of the Sri Venkateswara Oriental Research Institute, with his tenure attested in 1944 and 1954.

Padma Subrahmanyam is a scholar in Indology and history/archaeology. She studied at Ethiraj College for Women, Stella Maris College, and Annamalai University, completing research under T. N. Ramachandran around 1974–1979.
Padmanabh S. Jaini was a scholar of Indology and Buddhist studies who studied under Sukhlal Sanghvi. He served as a professor and later Professor Emeritus at the University of California, Berkeley.
Padmaprasad Upadhyaya Bhattarai was an Indologist and philosopher who studied under Vamacharana Bhattacharya. He held a post at Rajkiya Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya in Kathmandu, attested in 1957.

Pahalawattage Don Premasiri is a Buddhist studies and philosophy scholar who studied at Peradeniya, Cambridge, and Hawaiʻi. He held several academic appointments at the University of Peradeniya from 1963 to 2004 and served as president of the Buddhist Publication Society.

Palmira Brummett is a historian who earned degrees from the University of Chicago and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. She served as professor at the University of Tennessee (~1989–2011) and visiting professor at Brown University (2011–2016).
Palmo Kyi is a scholar in Tibetology who studied under Rinzin Thargyal, Hanna Havnevik, and Per Kværne.

Pamela D. Winfield is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Japanology, and religious studies. She held a post at Temple University (attested 2001) and served as Associate Professor of Religious Studies at Elon University (attested 2015–2017).
